mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 6.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery phase (as indicated by rising new home construction), consumer confidence and spending increase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past quarter indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 for 2 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based consumer and housing demand, which accelerates economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0%, the central bank's accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.04.
